swarm.name: The Keepers
swarm.blurb: A swarm of builders and collectors that repairs structures, gathers materials and guards the spaces it makes.

crew.name: Wren
crew.blurb: Field medic. Keeps the crew running with thread and solder.

crew.name: Ox
crew.blurb: Shield bearer. Has walked out of worse.

crew.name: Kestrel
crew.blurb: Breaker. Finds the seam in anything and pulls.

creatures.name: Mill Chip
creatures.blurb: Loose mill teeth gather around anyone carrying metal.

creatures.name: Willow Loop
creatures.blurb: Its tightening ring catches a weapon at the wrong moment.

creatures.name: Meadow Decoy
creatures.blurb: It hides among flowers and makes off with loose supplies.

creatures.name: Ovenback
creatures.blurb: It bakes small scouts in its belly. Break the oven before another batch emerges.

creatures.name: Court Mender
creatures.blurb: It patches damaged machines with borrowed parts. Stop its repairs first.

creatures.name: Coppice Cutter
creatures.blurb: It folds cut branches into cover for wounded machines.

creatures.name: Frame Examiner
creatures.blurb: It locks moving joints in place, including those of the crew.

creatures.name: Grain Harvester
creatures.blurb: It takes tools as if they were the next step in making bread.

creatures.name: Gridshell Weaver
creatures.blurb: It bends a lattice around itself and covers its damaged neighbors.

creatures.name: Bug House Warden
creatures.blurb: Its compartments open one by one to release scouts.

creatures.name: Collection Claimant
creatures.blurb: Its rack gathers tools and locks them behind swinging bars.

creatures.name: Keeper of the Humble Past
creatures.blurb: It seals people into furnished rooms and sends workers to repair every opening. Break its cover and stop its workers to let the rooms open.

creatures.name: Route Keeper
creatures.blurb: Keeps paths open and points out firm ground.

creatures.name: Barn Mender
creatures.blurb: A volunteer repairer who shares spare thread with Wren.

events.title: Drifting table
events.text: The table carries food and a purse toward the mill wheel. There is time to grab only one.

options.label: Take the food
options.result: Wren shares the dry food.

options.label: Take the purse
options.result: Ox hooks the purse ashore.

events.title: First things first
events.text: A stalled bread line has flour and a sealed cash box. Fixing one part will start the machinery again.

options.label: Bake the flour
options.result: The crew eats before the line starts.

options.label: Open the box
options.result: Kestrel finds coins as the mill starts.

events.title: Tight weave
events.text: A wreath holds a key to a tool case. The case has a coin tray and a set of bracing instructions. The closing wreath allows one reach.

options.label: Take the coins
options.result: The tray comes free before the weave tightens.

options.label: Study the brace
options.result: Ox learns to set his feet before the case closes.

events.title: Cutting cycle
events.text: A cutter is returning. The crew can carry poles to a shelter or salvage a dropped purse before it arrives.

options.label: Reinforce the shelter
options.result: The crew rests behind the poles.

options.label: Retrieve the purse
options.result: Kestrel recovers the purse and clears the path.

events.title: One tool
events.text: Two traders offer different payment for judging their dispute. Each wants the tool.

options.label: Award it to the left stall
options.result: The left trader pays from a tin box.

options.label: Award it to the right stall
options.result: The right trader shows Wren how to clear a fouled mechanism.

events.title: Straight chairs
events.text: A machine will open the cupboard after the chairs are aligned. The work will leave time to take either its supplies or its coins.

options.label: Take supplies
options.result: Wren packs the bandages.

options.label: Take coins
options.result: Ox pockets the coins before the machine returns.

story.intro: The swarm has taken over workshops and is carrying away fittings. Wren finds fresh seams in a locked room. Ox holds the door while Kestrel pulls it open. Inside, a table has been set for people who are not there.

chapters.title: Floors 1–5: Useful things
chapters.text: Machines collect tools, grain and timber. Kestrel thinks they are stripping the site for parts. Wren notices that damaged machines get repairs before the goods are moved.

chapters.title: Floors 6–10: Rooms under cover
chapters.text: The swarm builds rooms around its stores. Ox finds doors sealed from the outside. Wren finds blankets inside, carefully folded and unused.

chapters.title: Floors 11–15: A place held still
chapters.text: The rooms have hearths, tables and no working exits. The Keeper keeps repairing their walls. Kestrel marks the joints that hold its roof together.

story.bossIntro: The Keeper folds its lattice over a row of rooms. Workers bring more boards to seal the doors. Ox takes the first blow while Kestrel looks for a joint to open.
story.outro: The doors open. No one was inside, but each room was prepared for an occupant. A swarm carrier leaves with a sketch of a larger roof. The crew follows.

creatures.name: Prefab Panel
creatures.blurb: It plants itself across a doorway and braces.

creatures.name: Lace Bobbin
creatures.blurb: Its thread tangles the crew’s hands.

creatures.name: Orchard Pip
creatures.blurb: It rolls away with whatever fits in its basket.

creatures.name: Cottage Converter
creatures.blurb: It divides a room, then splits its own frame when damaged.

creatures.name: Roundhouse Thatcher
creatures.blurb: It shields damaged workers under fresh bundles of straw.

creatures.name: Gate Dog
creatures.blurb: It charges anyone approaching a gate.

creatures.name: Kiln Stoker
creatures.blurb: It sends small soot-coated workers out of its kiln.

creatures.name: Lace Mender
creatures.blurb: It stitches broken machines together. Cut short its repairs.

creatures.name: Building Bearer
creatures.blurb: It carries a whole wall and charges through obstacles to add it to the roof.

creatures.name: Pageant Director
creatures.blurb: It assigns machines to stations and calls replacements when interrupted.

creatures.name: Kiln Press
creatures.blurb: Its heavy lid cracks shields protecting the crew.

creatures.name: The Roof That Must Be Used
creatures.blurb: It gathers rooms beneath its roof and stations workers at every opening. It shelters people from the swarm outside, then refuses to let them leave.

creatures.name: Farm Keeper
creatures.blurb: Keeps the animals moving and holds gates for the crew.

creatures.name: Story Keeper
creatures.blurb: Remembers the people who used the buildings and helps Wren tend evacuees.

events.title: Two doors
events.text: A conservator is clear of the split room. Their bag and a coin box remain under the shifting frame. There is time for one.

options.label: Pull out the bag
options.result: Wren learns a quick stitch from the supplies.

options.label: Pull out the box
options.result: Kestrel slides the box out before the frame settles.

events.title: Gate duty
events.text: The farm team offers food or a purse for helping the flock through. Only one can be spared.

options.label: Take food
options.result: The flock passes and the crew eats.

options.label: Take the purse
options.result: The flock passes and the keeper pays.

events.title: Last baskets
events.text: The press is descending. Ox can pull out one basket before it lands.

options.label: Save the apples
options.result: The crew shares the unbruised fruit.

options.label: Save the purse
options.result: Ox retrieves the purse as the press closes.

events.title: Loose end
events.text: The loose bobbin can be traded, or its pattern can teach a way to catch an enemy off balance. Taking one chance unravels the thread.

options.label: Trade the bobbin
options.result: A nearby craftsperson pays for the intact bobbin.

options.label: Study the pattern
options.result: Kestrel learns where to snag a moving joint.

events.title: Hot chest
events.text: The chest holds coins and a steel wedge. Smoke forces a quick choice.

options.label: Grab the coins
options.result: Ox pulls out the purse and backs away.

options.label: Grab the wedge
options.result: Kestrel takes the wedge and leaves the chest to cool.

events.title: Last bundles
events.text: The roof crew can pay in food or teach a guarding stance. They need the same help either way.

options.label: Ask for food
options.result: The last bundles go up and the crew eats.

options.label: Learn the stance
options.result: Ox practices holding a gap while the bundles go up.

story.intro: The carrier reaches a place full of rescued buildings. The swarm joins their frames beneath a single roof. Kestrel expects another empty trap. A farm keeper asks the crew to open a gate.

chapters.title: Floors 1–5: Buildings on the move
chapters.text: Wall panels and roof bundles travel toward the same frame. Ox helps keep a route clear for the farm team. The swarm guards the route too, though it attacks anyone who tries to leave it.

chapters.title: Floors 6–10: Occupied shelter
chapters.text: The crew finds people sheltered under a swarm roof. They say it kept other machines out, then closed the doors on them. Wren treats a trapped worker. Kestrel stops calling the rooms stores.

chapters.title: Floors 11–15: A roof without a door
chapters.text: The roof takes in more buildings and more people. Its guards repair every exit. Ox holds an opening while the others guide people out; Kestrel traces its supports.

story.bossIntro: The roof lowers over the last open passage. Its workers rush to close the gap and shield one another. Wren gets the evacuees clear while Ox and Kestrel take on the frame.
story.outro: The roof falls open and the people leave. Among its supports is a damaged sample cabinet, packed with mismatched wood. The swarm takes the cabinet and heads for a place where it can identify the pieces.

creatures.name: Balsa Lifter
creatures.blurb: Several light lifters take loose equipment together.

creatures.name: Pore Drone
creatures.blurb: Its moving ring of holes catches limbs between the rays.

creatures.name: Abura Clerk
creatures.blurb: It repeatedly clamps the same object into two different drawers.

creatures.name: Warp Kiln
creatures.blurb: Its cupped boards close into a protective shell.

creatures.name: Sample Collector
creatures.blurb: It takes fragments of equipment to fill its specimen tray.

creatures.name: Burl Colony
creatures.blurb: It grows knotted patches over damaged machines.

creatures.name: Filter Hunter
creatures.blurb: It narrows its search until its clamps catch the crew.

creatures.name: Name Twins
creatures.blurb: One calls another from a cabinet. Rush it before the room fills.

creatures.name: Janka Bailiff
creatures.blurb: Its steel ball drives through a shield after a slow windup.

creatures.name: Strength Champion
creatures.blurb: It braces behind layered timber and tests the crew’s shields in return.

creatures.name: Endgrain Gatekeeper
creatures.blurb: It clamps a target for inspection while calling specimen drones.

creatures.name: Universal Xylarium
creatures.blurb: It collects specimens to identify the wood in its damaged shelter. It summons inspectors, shields them with drawers and sweeps the room with its roots. Conflicting samples leave gaps in its cabinet.

creatures.name: Doubtful Identifier
creatures.blurb: It offers several possible matches and asks for better evidence.

creatures.name: Sample Steward
creatures.blurb: It shares reference blocks and helps Wren repair the damaged cabinet.

events.title: Cupped boards
events.text: The case holds a purse and a useful repair guide. The boards are closing around it.

options.label: Take the purse
options.result: Ox pulls out the purse before the boards meet.

options.label: Read the guide
options.result: Wren reads the repair guide as the case closes.

events.title: Two maples
events.text: A sorter offers coins or a lesson for helping it compare endgrain. It can spare only one.

options.label: Take the coins
options.result: The sorter pays after the samples are compared.

options.label: Take the lesson
options.result: Kestrel learns to find a weakness at the end of a cut.

events.title: Sample trade
events.text: A trader offers either a purse or a shield technique for the crew’s spare sample.

options.label: Trade for coins
options.result: The trader takes the sample and hands over the purse.

options.label: Trade for instruction
options.result: Ox practices the technique while the trader packs the sample.

events.title: Stuck ball
events.text: The press shakes the ceiling. The crew can stop it and rest, or use the brief opening to pull its coin box free.

options.label: Stop the press
options.result: The crew rests once the ceiling is still.

options.label: Pull the coin box
options.result: Kestrel gets the box and scrambles clear of the first falling chips.

events.title: Dry air
events.text: Changing the vent will open one door and close the other. Behind them are food and a coin box.

options.label: Open the food store
options.result: Wren finds dry provisions.

options.label: Open the cash store
options.result: Ox brings out the box.

events.title: Different strengths
events.text: The dial opens one door at a time. One room holds a purse; another contains a diagram for a sweeping attack.

options.label: Open the purse room
options.result: The crew retrieves the purse.

options.label: Open the diagram room
options.result: Kestrel studies the diagram before the dial resets.

story.intro: The swarm brings the sample cabinet to a collection of wood. Its machines test and sort pieces for the damaged shelter. Wren finds old repairs inside the cabinet. Someone once kept it working with whatever wood was available.

chapters.title: Floors 1–5: Tests
chapters.text: Machines weigh, press and inspect samples. Kestrel sees them reject pieces that do not match a single measure. The cabinet keeps those rejects in a separate drawer.

chapters.title: Floors 6–10: The wrong answer
chapters.text: A surviving identifier offers several possible matches for the shelter wood. The swarm demands one certain answer and takes more samples. Ox protects the identifier while Wren compares the old repairs.

chapters.title: Floors 11–15: A workable repair
chapters.text: The repairs use several woods. No single sample will recreate the shelter exactly. Wren and the steward assemble a sound patch from the available pieces. Kestrel carries it toward the cabinet.

story.bossIntro: The Xylarium opens its drawers and calls inspectors to defend them. Its roots sweep across the floor. The crew must get through the guarded cabinet with Wren’s patch.
story.outro: Wren fits the patch into the damaged cabinet. The Xylarium tests it, leaves the drawer open and stops collecting. The shelter was its original job; it had been trying to rebuild it exactly, then keep its occupants safe inside. Ox props the door open. The swarm lets people pass.
